categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three main business segments: (1) Electrical automation equipment components including power electronic heat sinks and precision aluminum parts for automation and medical devices; (2) Automotive lightweight and thermal management components including motor housings, battery boxes, and heat sinks for new energy vehicles; (3) Clean energy products including heat exchangers for wind, solar, and energy storage systems. The company serves as a supplier of precision aluminum alloy components to global leading industrial customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in precision aluminum alloy component manufacturing using multiple forming technologies including metallurgical extrusion, mechanical combination, welding, and mechanical machining. Core technologies include high-efficiency heat sink manufacturing with various types (integral extrusion, compression, insertion, scraping, folding, copper-aluminum composite, heat pipe, and liquid cooling), precision CNC machining, custom tooling and fixture design, and advanced production process optimization. The company operates flexible automated production lines capable of handling multiple product types and specifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include global leading industrial companies such as ABB, Schneider Electric, Siemens, General Electric, and Vestas in the industrial automation sector. In automotive, customers include Toyota, Honda, Geely, Volvo, Audi, BMW, and BYD. The company serves markets in industrial automation, power electronics, automotive manufacturing, wind energy, solar energy, and energy storage sectors. Geographic markets include both domestic China and international markets, with exports representing approximately 20% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Tianjin. Major operating locations include Tianjin (main production base) and Changshu, Jiangsu (subsidiary facility). The company has established international presence through subsidiaries in Hong Kong (established 2024) and Thailand (established 2024) to support overseas business expansion and mitigate trade risks. International sales account for approximately 18-19% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources raw materials (primarily aluminum and copper ingots) from suppliers, performs value-added manufacturing and precision processing, and sells finished precision aluminum components directly to industrial equipment manufacturers and automotive OEMs. The company does not engage in retail or end-consumer sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing heat sink technology for clean energy applications (wind, solar, energy storage); (2) Developing lightweight aluminum components for new energy vehicles; (3) Enhancing manufacturing automation and digitalization; (4) Expanding international market presence through overseas production bases; (5) Continuous innovation in materials science, precision machining, and process optimization. R&D focuses on new material development, advanced manufacturing techniques, and expanding product applications in emerging energy sectors.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of precision aluminum components using a 'base aluminum price plus processing fee' pricing model. Base aluminum price is indexed to market prices (LME or Shanghai Futures Exchange), while processing fees represent the company's primary profit source and are determined based on product complexity and manufacturing requirements. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of goods, either upon delivery/pickup for domestic sales or upon export for international sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic supplier of precision aluminum components for industrial automation and automotive applications. Key competitive advantages include advanced manufacturing capabilities, strong customer relationships with global leaders, technical expertise, and quality management systems. The company competes with other precision metal component manufacturers but maintains differentiation through customization capabilities, technical innovation, and reliable supply chain management.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 622 million yuan, down 6.4% from 665 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 55.3 million yuan in 2024, down 26.6% from 75.4 million yuan in 2023. Total assets were 854 million yuan at year-end 2024. The company has experienced revenue decline in 2024 due to reduced orders from subsidiary Changshu facility and market competition, though maintains stable profitability and strong balance sheet with 800 million yuan in shareholder equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on providing integrated solutions for precision aluminum component manufacturing with emphasis on: (1) Customization - tailored products designed collaboratively with customers; (2) Quality - comprehensive quality management systems and advanced testing capabilities; (3) Technical expertise - deep experience in aluminum alloy materials, design, and manufacturing processes; (4) Reliability - consistent on-time delivery and responsive customer service; (5) Innovation - continuous development of new materials, processes, and product applications. The company differentiates through its ability to combine design, tooling, and manufacturing expertise into complete solutions for complex industrial applications.
